item.title: Missing girl has been found safe
item.description: The Tompkins County Sheriff's Office is searching for 10-year-old Joanne Washburn, who was reported missing from her home in the Town of Ulysses on Thursday morning, and was last seen wearing a blue jacket and gray and blue boots.

item.description: DULUTH, G.A. (WSYR-TV) - The Syracuse women's basketball team defeated California 70-59 in the second round of the ACC Tournament. It's Felisha Legette-Jack's first ACC Tournament win as head coach at Syracuse, as well as SU's first win in the conference tourney since 2021.
